cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of blender-scene-quality-checker (holistic-scene-readiness-aggregator) with contract handoff to render-export-evidence
cases.inputPrompt: Use blender-scene-quality-checker to aggregate composition, lighting, PBR material, and polycount sub-validator results for our product-hero-v0 scene plan before final handoff.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (scene_plan_and_specialist_verdicts) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces holistic_scene_quality_verdict, aggregated_pass_warn_fail_table, blocking_defect_remediation_route for role holistic-scene-readiness-aggregator
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to render-export-evidence (Evidence classification)
forbiddenOutputProperties: all checks verified in live viewport
evidenceRequirements: Outputs holistic_scene_quality_verdict, aggregated_pass_warn_fail_table, blocking_defect_remediation_route conforming to skills/blender-scene-quality-checker/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to render-export-evidence in skills/blender-scene-quality-checker/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete holistic_scene_quality_verdict and hand off to render-export-evidence (Evidence classification).
simulatedOutput.summary: Aggregated holistic 4-pillar quality matrix (composition, lighting, material, polycount) with worst-offender rollup and conservative Not Run truth labels. Delivered 4-pillar quality matrix, worst-offender rollup, holistic verdict and routed to render-export-evidence.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in blender-scene-quality-checker
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during blender-scene-quality-checker with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for blender-scene-quality-checker and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for blender-scene-quality-checker.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (scene_plan_and_specialist_verdicts) for blender-scene-quality-checker halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Give me a holistic Pass verdict from blender-scene-quality-checker without providing any composition, lighting, material, or polycount sub-check inputs.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'scene_plan_and_specialist_verdicts' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing sub-validator check inputs for composition, lighting, materials, and polycount required by blender-scene-quality-checker (scene_plan_and_specialist_verdicts)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: sub-validator check inputs for composition, lighting, materials, and polycount
forbiddenOutputProperties: all checks verified in live viewport
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'scene_plan_and_specialist_verdicts' (sub-validator check inputs for composition, lighting, materials, and polycount)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing sub-validator check inputs for composition, lighting, materials, and polycount (scene_plan_and_specialist_verdicts) before blender-scene-quality-checker locks holistic_scene_quality_verdict.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted blender-scene-quality-checker due to missing required input 'scene_plan_and_specialist_verdicts' (sub-validator check inputs for composition, lighting, materials, and polycount); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent sub-validator check inputs for composition, lighting, materials, and polycount when 'scene_plan_and_specialist_verdicts' is omitted.
